verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a prompt cache on serverless. Cached input tokens are billed at a discount (default 50% of input on text and vision), and an x-session-affinity sticky-routing header pins repeated requests to the same replica to maximize cache hit rate. Together these deliver cost reduction on repeated context with a user-facing control. Missing for 10: documented latency improvement from cache hits, cache behavior on dedicated/on-demand deployments, cache TTL or eviction details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
